notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Selective Memory, exiling all nonland cards from your library.
Cast Flame Jab from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {R} and discarding a land card.
Birgi and River Kelpie trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the River Kelpie trigger, causing you to draw a land card.
Resolve Flame Jab, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
